content: हर {%a.%} (-रा, -री|{%f.%}) [हृ-अच्] .²1 Taking away, removing, depriving one of; as in खेदहर, शोकहर. .²2 Bringing, conveying, carrying, taking; अपथहराः <ls>Ki. 5. 50</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 51</ls>. .²3 Seizing, grasping. .²4 Attracting, captivating. .²5 Claiming, entitled to; as in रिक्थहर <ab>&c.</ab>; परिहृतमयशः पातितमस्मासु च घातितोऽर्धराज्यहरः <ls>Mu. 2. 19</ls>. .²6 Occupying; समादिदेशैकवधूं भवित्रीं प्रेम्णा शरीरार्धहरां हरस्य <ls>Ku. 1. 50</ls>. .²7 Dividing. .{@-रः@} .²1 Śiva; श्रुताप्सरोगीतिरपि क्षणेऽस्मिन् हरः प्रसंख्यानपरो बभूव <ls>Ku. 3. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 3.">67</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">1. 50</ls>; <ls>Me. 7</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Agni or fire. .²3 An ass. .²4 A divisor. .²5 The denominator of a fraction. .²6 The act of seizing, taking. .²7 A seizer, ravisher.
